evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 7 semesters semesters

notes: Tuition: 3500 EUR/semester is the non-EU fee stated on the programme page; the same page also states 2800 EUR/semester for EU-students. The page says two semesters' tuition fee payment is required. No dated application deadline is stated on the supplied pages (the FAQ and contact pages give no dates, and the programme page lists 'Application for admission' without a deadline), so no intakes fact is included. The pages do not name a formal document list; the language test scores are quoted as equivalent level with 'no certificate required', so certificateRequired is false, not a document requirement. Admitted applicants who do not meet the minimum language requirements may be offered the English Language Preparatory Program (one or two semesters) — this is a possibility, not a requirement.

note.fr: Un entretien d'admission en ligne et un test de mathématiques en ligne (30 minutes, 10 QCM) font partie de la procédure de sélection.
note.en: An online admission interview and an online mathematics test (30 minutes, 10 multiple-choice questions) are part of the selection process.

evidence.quote: All applicants have to participate in an online admission interview.

note.fr: La moyenne générale annuelle et celle de l'examen final doivent être supérieures à 50 %, et la note de mathématiques du lycée supérieure à 60 %.
note.en: The GPA must be above 50% annually and in the final exam, and the high school math grade above 60%.

evidence.quote: GPA: above 50% - annually and in the final exam

note.fr: Les documents de candidature doivent être en anglais ou en hongrois ; sinon, joindre une traduction anglaise avec des copies vérifiées de l'original.
note.en: Application documents are accepted in English/Hungarian; if not, attach an English translation together with verified copies of the original.

evidence.quote: The entry qualification documents are accepted in the following languages: English / Hungarian.
